title: The State of Dental Practice Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 13). The state of dental practice websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/dental/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to independent dental practices
findings: Only 28% of the 135 independent dental practice websites we scanned say which insurance they take.
A typical site answers four of the eight questions patients ask before choosing (mean 3.7).
The median overall score is 77 out of 100 (mean 76).
The least-answered questions are "Are you taking new patients?" (22%), "What will it cost?" (23%) and "Do you take my insurance?" (28%).
The best-answered are "When are you open?" (79%) and "Can I book online?" (62%).
General and family have the highest median score (78), against 77 for orthodontics, 77 for pediatric and 74 for cosmetic and implants.
91% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).
59% fail "Dentist or MedicalClinic structured data" (Schema.org · Dentist).
Kinds of practice differ in median score by at least 3 points.

questions.label: Appointments can be booked or requested online

technical.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image, defer scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on the phone of someone in pain.

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme.
agencyProblems.pitch: Parts of the site are hard to read, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Says whether it is taking new patients
agencyProblems.question: Are you taking new patients?
agencyProblems.fix: Say plainly on the home page that the practice is welcoming new patients, with one line on what the first visit involves.
agencyProblems.pitch: A new patient cannot tell from your site whether you would even see them.

agencyProblems.label: Shows prices or a membership plan
agencyProblems.question: What will it cost?
agencyProblems.fix: Publish prices for the common visits (exam, cleaning, X-rays) or a membership plan with its monthly cost.
agencyProblems.pitch: Patients without insurance fear the bill most. Your site gives them no number at all.

agencyProblems.label: Says which insurance it takes
agencyProblems.question: Do you take my insurance?
agencyProblems.fix: An insurance page that names every plan the practice is in network with, or says clearly that it is fee-for-service, linked from the home page.
agencyProblems.pitch: "Do you take my insurance?" is the first question a new patient has, and your site makes them call to ask.
